title: Omega-Cube: A Multi-Dimensional Hierarchical Graph Memory System with Holographic Encoding, Quantum-Inspired Annealing, and Diffusion-Based Retrieval
description: Omega-Cube is a multi-dimensional hierarchical graph memory engine integrating tensor hierarchies, holographic encoding, quantum-inspired annealing, diffusion graph sampling, and gray-scale validation for LLM agents. Includes full Python implementation (2,500+ lines), LaTeX paper, benchmarks, and comprehensive roadmap.
